title: Sparse eras.json silently zero-pads missing eras; the FSM accepts an advance into a phantom era row
detail: An eras.json with rows {1,3} loads clean: era 2 becomes a zero Era_Row. era_row(2) and era_advance_validate (bounds = len(cat.eras)) treat the hole as valid, so era_step fires state.era=2 with empty roster/unlocks and demand_era=0 — no contiguity or defined-row guard anywhere.
recommended_fix: Fail-fast at load when rows are non-contiguous (after the loop, reject any cat.eras[i].era == 0), or make era_row/era_advance_validate reject rows with era == 0.

title: demand_era is validated at load but never read at runtime — the director keys demand by state.era, so invariant (b) checks a different row than the one that spawns
evidence:
plan := scripted_plan_demand(cat, state.era, tick)
(core/demand.odin:49) if era == 0 || int(era) > len(cat.demand.eras) {
		return plan // empty — no demand content for this era
(core/demand.odin:52) de := &cat.demand.eras[era-1]
(core/catalog.odin:1232) drow := &cat.demand.eras[de-1]
(core/era_test.odin:51) make_row(cat, 4, "real_time", "Real-Time", 3, {ei, si}, {res, rt, sb, ch, cp, rm, rh}, {na, std, wd})
detail: The loader range-checks demand_era and validates roster-subset against demand.eras[demand_era-1], but the runtime spawns from demand.eras[state.era-1]. With demand_era != era (permitted), the spawning row is unchecked, and era > len(demand.eras) yields a silent no-demand era — the diff's own era-4 test row exercises exactly that (3 demand eras), unasserted.
recommended_fix: Either enforce demand_era == era at load, or route the director through the era row's demand_era; also reject advance targets whose runtime demand row is absent.
